Comparative benchmarks

This page lists every comparative claim the benchmark pages have advertised, one cell per configuration and scenario. A cell shows the admission status the evidence supports and the reason codes behind it; a number appears only for a cell admitted from retained observations.

Scenario definitions and the Scenario A semantic gate are contracts, not results: see the related pages below.

Every comparative result published before 2026-11-01 was withdrawn; the records are retained as forensic evidence. The append-only invalidation ledger has 12 entries; 9 of them name the defect ids behind the withdrawal and 6 of them enumerate the withdrawn records by id (the rest name them by file and campaign commit). 5 of 20 history records are withdrawn without a ledger entry, by the admission rule forensic-record-not-admissible: no history record is admissible as a current claim.

Cell status vocabulary

  • valid-observed: admitted from retained v2 observations
  • product-failure: the product ran and failed; failure counts are shown
  • invalid-measurement: evidence exists but cannot support the claim (reason codes name why)
  • blocked: cannot be measured until a named prerequisite exists
  • unsupported: the configuration cannot express this claim
  • not-measured: no observation exists

The named smoke profile scenario-a-smoke-v1: the canonical workload executed end to end with per-request correctness and complete accounting. A smoke cell never carries throughput, latency quantiles or a ratio.
